attestation.statement: This index and bundle were created after campaign completion. They preserve the observed result bytes but do not establish preregistration, a launch-time source freeze, or an external timestamp.

bundle.format: deterministic GNU tar + gzip(level=9, mtime=0, empty filename)

excluded: per-record robust duplicates already represented by aggregate records.jsonl streams
included: screen launch/status, both screen summaries, and frozen confirmation selection
aggregate records plus run/summary/normalization controls for all three robust runs
